tools.name: scan_post_quantum
tools.description: Check whether a domain's TLS is using post-quantum (hybrid ML-KEM) key exchange.

tools.name: scan_domain_trust
tools.description: Audit a domain's DNS, TLS, certificates, and email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/DNSSEC).

tools.name: scan_security_headers
tools.description: Grade a domain's HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, and more).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_post_quantum · Public sink: scan_post_quantum, scan_domain_trust.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_post_quantum · Public sink: scan_post_quantum, scan_domain_trust

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
